# Cue-Flow

> Cue-Flow is a free, privacy-first teleprompter that runs locally in your browser.
> No accounts. No tracking. No saved data. Refreshing the page clears everything.
> Optional donations support the project and contribute to charitable causes with transparency.

## Main application

- https://cue-flow.app/
  The main Cue-Flow web app including the editor, teleprompter, mirror mode,
  present mode, and all controls.

## About, Privacy, Terms, Support

All informational sections (About, Privacy, Terms of Use, Support Cue-Flow,
and Contacts) are included within the main page interface.

## Key facts

- Runs entirely in the browser
- User text is never stored or transmitted
- Designed for focused creators and presenters
- Free to use with optional donations
- Donations support the project and charitable causes
